commands: rm -rf build && mkdir -p build/accessors-classes build/json-smart-classes deps
javac -nowarn -encoding UTF-8 -source 8 -target 8 -cp deps/asm-9.1.jar -d build/accessors-classes $(find src/accessors-smart/src/main/java -name '*.java' | LC_ALL=C sort)
javac -nowarn -encoding UTF-8 -source 8 -target 8 -cp deps/asm-9.1.jar:build/accessors-smart.jar -d build/json-smart-classes $(find src/json-smart/src/main/java -name '*.java' | LC_ALL=C sort)
notes: The modules accessors-smart and json-smart of the vulnerable commit (2.4.8 plus two unreleased JSONArray/JSONObject constructors, the parent of fix 5b3205d): accessors-smart/src/main/java compiled with javac -source 8 -target 8 against asm 9.1 (Maven Central, the version the fixture pom uses), then json-smart/src/main/java against asm 9.1 and that jar, each packed with jar, as the evaluation's jars were made; the project's Maven build is not used. json-smart-action is not built (the harness does not use it). Fixed: json-smart and accessors-smart 2.4.9, the first release with 5b3205d, with asm 9.3 (their dependency), which replaces asm 9.1.
